exposure: Collaborative models (CM) of intrapartum care shared between midwives and obstetricians
cohort: Pregnant women receiving care at either a maternity hospital using a collaborative model of care (MRJ) or a pool of hospitals not using a collaborative model (NB)
finding: Shared care between midwives and obstetricians at MRJ was associated with a higher frequency of evidence-based practices, lower use of interventions, and lower c-section rates compared to hospitals without a collaborative model.
